claims.text: the hit set holds every reference to SessionStart over the name forms this pass searched

Both hooks files register one SessionStart group with matcher * and three --soft handlers through hooks/run-hook.py: install-git-hooks.sh --quiet (timeout 15), update-notice.sh (timeout 15) and repo-list SessionStart (timeout 60).
Claude Code reads hooks/hooks.json by its default path (no hooks key in .claude-plugin/plugin.json); Codex reads hooks/hooks.codex.json through .codex-plugin/plugin.json:53.

In plugin mode hooks/run-hook.py runs hooks/<handler> with inherited stdin and stdout, passes its whole environment plus AFK_PLUGIN_ROOT, applies no repository or session filter, and exits 0 under --soft, so a plugin handler's stdout reaches the harness as written in every session that has the plugin enabled.
